root = Stack([
  title,
  transferForm,
  successCallout
])

title = TextContent("Transfer Funds", "large-heavy")

$fromAccount = "checking"
$toAccount = "savings"
$amount = 0
$showSuccess = false

transferForm = Form("transferForm", formButtons, [
  fromAccountField,
  toAccountField,
  amountField
])

fromAccountField = FormControl("From Account", Select("fromAccount", fromAccountOptions, null, {required: true}, $fromAccount))
fromAccountOptions = [
  SelectItem("checking", "Checking (****1234)"),
  SelectItem("savings", "Savings (****5678)"),
  SelectItem("credit", "Credit Card (****9101)")
]

toAccountField = FormControl("To Account", Select("toAccount", toAccountOptions, null, {required: true}, $toAccount))
toAccountOptions = [
  SelectItem("savings", "Savings (****5678)"),
  SelectItem("checking", "Checking (****1234)"),
  SelectItem("credit", "Credit Card (****9101)")
]

amountField = FormControl("Amount", Input("amount", "0.00", "number", {required: true, min: 0.01}, $amount))

formButtons = Buttons([
  transferButton
])

transferButton = Button("Transfer", Action([@Set($showSuccess, true), @Reset($amount)]), "primary")

successCallout = Callout("success", "Transfer Confirmed", "You have successfully transferred $" + $amount + " from " + $fromAccount + " to " + $toAccount + ".", $showSuccess)
